title: Add CI tasks-completion gates
description: Integrate completion checker into .github/workflows/integration-tests.yml with phased governance: soft warning job plus conditional hard-fail job for release-critical mode.

criteria: Workflow includes a soft-warn completion job that always reports metrics.
Workflow includes a hard-fail completion job with explicit trigger condition.
Job graph avoids circular dependencies and preserves current baseline gates.

files.change: Add tasks-completion-soft-warn and tasks-completion-hard-fail jobs wired after baseline checks using scripts/check_tasks_completion.py.

implementation: Add Python setup and dependency install steps matching existing workflow style.
Run checker in soft mode with continue-on-error true for observability stage.
Add hard gate variant with strict mode and explicit condition (e.g., release flag/branch policy).
test: Validate workflow syntax and run local simulation commands equivalent to new jobs to confirm expected exit behavior.
